verdict.rationale: Bruno supports importing Postman collections (with preserve-scripts option for import/export) and stores collections as plain text files on the filesystem, which are inherently portable and git-friendly; this is corroborated by community testimonials about moving from Postman/Insomnia. missing for 10: explicit documentation of export to other formats (e.g., OpenAPI/Insomnia export) and independent verification of round-trip fidelity beyond Postman import.
